record.reason: OPSD-V post-trains few-step autoregressive video generators with cache-aware teacher supervision; it preserves the same sampler, number of denoising steps, and inference KV-cache path. Quality improves without extra inference work, but it does not itself reduce inference cost.
record.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
